In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] '''attacked''' an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] outpost on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ultaar/Legends|Ultaar]], and the attack resulted in the complete destruction of the base.
